messages:
rachel-release: Heads-up: planning to remove runtime pin for 3.0.1 from hosted canary tonight 01:00 UTC. Need SDK compatibility confirmation and rollback criteria before we touch production.

deploybot: Noted. Current pin mapping: runtime 3.0.1 -> models: llama4q, gptx3, quant-x1. Scheduled unpin window 1769609999 (01:00 UTC). Will set canary targets on command.

sam-sre: Quick ask: any customers still on SDK 2.2 or older? We should mark exemptions if so.

nina-eng: SDK matrix: recommended >=2.5.0. SDK 2.3 had a streaming handshake edgecase that can desync with the new runtime. 2.2 and earlier are unsupported for 3.0.x.

alex-prd: Customer Orion (Dedicated) reported running SDK 2.2 in a few clusters. CS, we'll need to coordinate. @jorge-cs can you confirm if Orion can upgrade in the short term?

jorge-cs: Orion ops informed. They requested a 24h notice and prefer staged exposure. We'll ask for a brief maintenance window but can accept a limited canary.

rachel-release: Proposed rollout: hosted/eu-central sequence-only canary (5% traffic) -> monitor 20m -> expand to hosted global canary 40% if stable -> final unpin if green for 1h. Rollback via pin to 3.0.0 if triggers hit.

deploybot: Canary command prepared:
```
deploybot unpin --runtime 3.0.1 --targets hosted:eu-central:tag=sequence --scheduled 1769609999 --ratio 5
```

daria-ops: Monitoring plan: watch error_rate, decode_failures, streaming_handshakes, p99_latency, and token_gap. Alerts: error_rate > 0.5% OR decode_failures > 3/min OR streaming_handshakes_fail > 2/min -> roll back.

nina-eng: Add a specific guard for back-compat tokenization differences. If token_split_mismatch_rate > 0.1% for any model, pause rollout and fallback mapping for that model to 3.0.0.

rachel-release: Rollback commands: `deploybot pin --runtime 3.0.0 --scope hosted` and per-model pin: `deploybot pin --runtime 3.0.0 --models quant-x1 --scope hosted:us-west`. We should include the runbook link in the announcement (internal only).

sam-sre: I'll create a transient dashboard with 15s resolution for the first 30m and alert into #eng-oncall. Also adding an automated revert job if streaming_handshakes_fail spikes.

deploybot: Rollout started at 1769609999 to hosted/eu-central (sequence tag), 5%.

rachel-release: I'll draft a short internal blurb for #announcements after the first green check. CS: ping @jorge-cs when we hit 20m.

jorge-cs: Received. Orion notified about limited canary. They asked to be kept in the loop.

deploybot: Canary update 1769610120: 3m in, no alerts. p99 +2% vs baseline.

nina-eng: Seeing a handful of decode warnings on quant-x1 for long-context streaming, but no catastrophic failures. Tracking.

daria-ops: 10m check: decode_failures 0.9/min, error_rate 0.06%, streaming_handshakes stable. Continue watch.

deploybot: Canary green at 1769611199 (20m). Expanding to hosted global canary 40%.

rachel-release: Expanding now. Keep the automated reverts armed.

deploybot: Expansion initiated. Targets: hosted:* tag=canary ratio=40.

daria-ops: Mid-expansion telemetry: quant-x1 in us-west shows a small uptick in decode_failures at 1769612500 -> 2.4/min. Still below abort but flagged. Collecting traces.

nina-eng: Correlating traces: quant-x1 fallback path invoked for some kernels under longseq+stream. That causes larger GC pauses leading to decode slowdowns. Patch branch created (hotfix/quant-kernel-fix).

sam-sre: Given the kernel fallback root cause, I'd prefer a regional pinback for quant-x1 in us-west while we validate the hotfix on a separate canary. Faster remediation.

jorge-cs: Orion reported one anomalous output sample; we've pushed logs. This is likely the region where they're routed. They asked for a rollback if anything more than one tenant is affected.

rachel-release: Okay, plan: do a localized pinback for quant-x1 in us-west to restore behavior, keep other models on 3.0.1. Then run the hotfix on a dedicated canary tomorrow and iterate.

deploybot: Executing regional pinback now: `deploybot pin --runtime 3.0.0 --models quant-x1 --scope hosted:us-west` -> job started 1769613000.

deploybot: Pinback complete 1769613060. Quant-x1 in hosted:us-west remapped to 3.0.0.

daria-ops: Post-pinback metrics: decode_failures for quant-x1 in us-west dropped back to baseline within 3 minutes. Streaming_handshakes stable.

nina-eng: We'll validate the hotfix build and submit for canary. If green, we can re-unpin regionally and proceed.

sam-sre: Dashboard will keep heightened retention for 4 hours and then scale back. Alerts remain active.

jorge-cs: Orion is satisfied with the regional pinback and appreciates the quick containment. They'll await the hotfix canary before upgrading their SDK.

rachel-release: Thanks team. Action items: 1) update release notes with SDK compat (>=2.5.0) and note regional pinback for quant-x1; 2) CS to follow up with Orion (jorge); 3) nina to open hotfix canary thread.

deploybot: Final status: unpin partially applied (global except quant-x1 us-west). Thread closing; follow-ups posted in #eng-releases and #eng-ml.

rachel-release: :white_check_mark: Great work. We'll reconvene after hotfix canary results.
